notes.title: Anomaly Presentation and Easy Mode Achievement Completion Fixes
notes.content:
- Improved clarity of the invisibility display during time travel anomalies.
- Fixed an issue where the achievement for completing the game on Easy difficulty could be unlocked.

notes.title: Easy difficulty fix
notes.content: Fixed checkpoints on Easy difficulty. Increased to 3 locations: 9, 6, and 3 remaining.
